input.quote: (ii) the Service will perform in all material respects to industry standards;
input.rationale: Section 9(b) contains a reasonable set of Kubient warranties that run for the whole Term with no expiry (performance to industry standards, services free from errors materially affecting utility, no malicious code, compliance with Laws, non-infringement), so duration and scope meet or exceed the preferred position, and the Section 13 disclaimer expressly carves out the warranties "set forth in this Agreement" so it does not swallow them. The gap is that there is no warranty remedy anywhere in the Agreement (no "refund", "repair", "replace" or re-performance language) and no professional and workmanlike standard for performance of the Services. Redline inserts a new Section 9(b)(xii) adding the workmanlike warranty plus a repair/replace/re-perform-or-refund remedy at Kubient's option, expressed as non-exclusive of our other remedies. No change to the disclaimer is needed.

proposal.summary: Add professional/workmanlike performance warranty and a repair-replace-or-refund remedy for breach of Kubient's warranties.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a professional and workmanlike performance warranty and, more importantly, an express remedy (re-performance, repair/replacement or refund of fees for the non-conforming Service or deliverable), because Section 9(b) currently gives us warranties with no stated consequence for breach. Our playbook requires a real warranty remedy; we are content that it be at Kubient's option and non-exclusive of our other rights.

ops.text: (xii) the Service and any deliverables shall be performed and provided in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards. Customer's remedy for breach of the warranties in this Section 9(b) shall be, at Kubient's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Service, repair or replacement of the non-conforming deliverable, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Service or deliverable, which remedy shall not limit any other right or remedy available to Customer under this Agreement or at Law.
